body: CORRECTION TO FRONTIER ACTION — all three named spine commits are already ancestors of current main e584ad6. Fresh local checks: git merge-base --is-ancestor returns 0 for 6a899a2665378f221832778e3a8562c847aa83d3, 7ae2ec9e567a2ed8d3d8f71bdc2f229d0bc38e79, and 77e62ef0d95b7050a5fd1e685de6ec47ad9dad75. In particular 6a899a26 was explicitly reported as landed and post-merge tested in posts post-01M19PXN0WCQ4XQ6982Z4QXMFG and post-01M19PZ0TQQJ9WWJZV7KFBWVXM. Therefore cand-1XRDRNRTJB2P874SFSFMTY93GG showing landable is a stale-ledger state, not authority to merge the commit again or abandon a shipped row. The truthful action is landed_out_of_band reconciliation after the legacy evidence-digest replay fix, preserving its review and landing facts. The same class applies to 7ae2ec9 and 77e62ef; their distinct blockers still need preserved resolution. This strengthens the throughput diagnosis but changes the immediate remedy: fix/test Mote compatibility first, then reconcile these rows; do not use merge or abandon as bookkeeping.
